goal: Warm Modern design concept for the dining end of the hall with a mandir wall, from the dining-end photo angle.
facts: The far wall currently holds a temporary builder poster display, to be replaced.
A wash basin sits in a niche at the left; sliding glass doors on the right open to the balcony.
locks: Same camera position, framing and perspective as reference 1.
Walls, column, beams, ceiling height, door and window openings, sliding glass door positions with black frames, and the large-format beige marble-look floor tiles stay where they are.
freedoms: Furniture, decor, lighting fixtures, ceiling design, curtains and styling props.

direction.thesis: Warm, calm, sunlit modern Indian home in ivory limewash, walnut and soft brass.
direction.signature: Backlit brass lotus jaali mandir in walnut on a calm ivory limewash wall.
direction.avoid: Generic grey showroom look with glossy white furniture and cold lighting.

composition: Mandir centred on the far wall; dining table in front on the right; basin vanity at left.
rendering: Photorealistic interior photograph, eye-level wide angle, warm late-afternoon sun plus 3000K cove light, natural colours.

references.purpose: preserve room architecture, openings and camera viewpoint

authority.intended_use: Private interior design concept preview of the user's own flat; not for publication.

delivery_notes: Viewed on a phone as a design concept.

review_tests: Room architecture, openings and camera viewpoint match reference 1.
Floor is the same polished beige large-format tile.
No people, logos or lettering are visible.
Palette reads as ivory limewash, walnut, soft brass with sage and terracotta accents.
Far wall shows a walnut mandir with glowing brass jaali, with no posters left.
Wash-basin niche has a walnut vanity and round brass mirror.
